entities.summary: The Russian State Arctic and Antarctic Museum is a museum in St. Petersburg, Russia. It was established in November 1930 as part of the Soviet Arctic and Antarctic Research Institute, but was not opened until six years later. Arctic and Antarctic Museum is a museum in Europe, established in 1930. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
